## Transcription provenance

Step: 1/3
Model: provider/exact-model-id
Source: https://example.org/printed-edition

For a human verification PR, replace Step and Model with:

Review: [human]
Proofreader: @github-username

## What changed

Work unit and source PDF pages:
LilyPond version:
Rendered PDF attached or linked:
Initial pass and targeted correction pass (what changed after comparing the render):
Further validation pass, if done:
Pages/systems compared:
Unresolved passages or limitations:
Apparent mistakes or ambiguities in the printed source:

For a correction, include the finding link, affected revision, page/system/measure,
and what the source and transcription each show. For human verification, give the
exact approved revision and full review coverage.

## Checks

- [ ] The LilyPond compiles without errors.
- [ ] The rendered PDF was compared page by page with the printed source, including notes, rhythm, voices, markings, text, and pedal where present.
- [ ] An initial encoding and at least one targeted correction pass were completed; a third validation pass was considered.
- [ ] Apparent source errors were preserved and documented separately from encoding errors.
- [ ] The music was entered visually from the printed edition; Audiveris and all other OMR/OCR, score-recognition, MusicXML, MIDI, and existing digital transcriptions were not used.
- [ ] For Steps 1–2, the agent did not inspect the other attempt.
- [ ] If this is human verification, the original and rendered PDFs were compared throughout the stated scope and the exact revision is identified.
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py --write` was run.
